mentalHealth.intro: Mental health and substance use treatment is covered like other medical care on your plan. What you pay depends on your plan — check the Coverage tab for your exact costs.

behavioralHealth.title: Mental Health & Substance Use Care
behavioralHealth.summary: Therapy, psychiatric care, and higher levels of care are all covered benefits.
behavioralHealth.bullet4: Inpatient, residential, partial hospitalization (PHP), and intensive outpatient (IOP) programs
behavioralHealth.notCovered: Not covered: marriage and family counseling, educational groups, and court-ordered treatment.
behavioralHealth.preauth: Inpatient, residential, PHP, and IOP care need DMBA's approval first. In an emergency, get care — then have your provider call DMBA within two business days of admission.

abaTherapy.title: ABA Therapy for Autism
abaTherapy.summary: Covered for a confirmed autism spectrum disorder diagnosis when provided by a board-certified behavior analyst (BCBA or BCBA-D).
abaTherapy.bullet1: A diagnosis from a psychiatrist, psychologist, neurologist, or developmental pediatrician
abaTherapy.bullet2: A functional behavioral assessment before therapy starts
abaTherapy.preauth: Preauthorization is required — including the initial assessment.
abaTherapy.byuNote: Not available on BYU student plans.

erVsUrgentCare.title: Emergency Room vs. Urgent Care
erVsUrgentCare.summary: Both are covered. For anything that isn't life-threatening, urgent care is usually faster and costs you less.
erVsUrgentCare.bullet1: Use the emergency room for life-threatening emergencies
erVsUrgentCare.bullet2: Follow-up care at the ER costs the same as a regular ER visit — see your doctor or urgent care instead
erVsUrgentCare.bullet3: Other services during a visit, like labs and imaging, are covered at their own benefit levels
erVsUrgentCare.preauth: If a visit turns into a hospital stay, your provider needs to call DMBA within two business days.

mentalHealth.disclaimer: This is a summary of how these benefits work. Your plan's coverage details are on the Coverage tab, and your plan documents are the final word. If you're in crisis, call or text 988.

viewIdCard.question: How do I view my ID card?
viewIdCard.answer: Tap the Profile tab, then select Account. Tap "Access ID Card" to view your digital insurance card. You can flip it to see front and back, and download or share it.

findProvider.question: How do I find an in-network provider?
findProvider.answer: Tap the Search tab at the bottom of the screen to access the provider directory. You can search by name, specialty, or location to find in-network providers.

fileClaim.question: How do I file a claim?
fileClaim.answer: Tap the Activity tab, then select Claims. Use the "Submit a Claim" button to start the claims process. You will need your provider information and service details.

checkDeductible.question: How do I check my deductible?
checkDeductible.answer: Your deductible progress is shown on the Home tab. Tap any progress bar to see detailed in-network and out-of-network deductible and out-of-pocket maximum information.

contactDmba.question: How do I contact DMBA?
contactDmba.answer: Tap "Contact Support" below to view phone numbers and business hours. You can call Salt Lake City at 801-578-5600 or toll free at 800-777-3622. Office hours are Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM Mountain Time (Thursday 9 AM–5 PM).

changeLanguage.question: How do I change the app language?
changeLanguage.answer: Go to Profile → Settings. At the top of the Settings tab, tap the language toggle to switch between English and Español.

enableBiometric.question: How do I enable Face ID or fingerprint login?
enableBiometric.answer: Go to Profile → Settings → Privacy & Security. Toggle on "Face ID / Fingerprint" to enable biometric login. You will be prompted on your next sign-in.

emergency.question: What should I do in a medical emergency?
emergency.answer: Call 911 immediately for life-threatening emergencies. For urgent care, find a network provider using the Search tab. Emergency care is covered even out-of-network. Keep your DMBA ID card accessible for providers.

spendingClaims.title: Submit a claim
spendingClaims.entryPointHint: Request reimbursement or document a card payment
spendingClaims.loadError: We couldn't load the claim form. Please try again.
spendingClaims.vendorCopyNote: This information comes from DMBA's spending-account administrator and is only available in English.

discardGuard.title: Discard this claim?
discardGuard.message: If you leave now, anything you've entered — including any photos you've taken — will be lost.

substantiate.title: Send a receipt

discardGuard.title: Discard this receipt?
discardGuard.message: If you leave now, the photo you've taken won't be sent.

substantiate.loadError: We couldn't load your card payments. Please try again.

pick.question: Which card payment is this receipt for?
pick.subtitle: These are the payments we've been asked to document. Pick the one that matches your receipt.

capture.offlineBlock: You're offline, so this receipt can't be sent yet. It's saved — come back when you have a connection.

empty.title: Nothing needs a receipt
empty.body: None of your recent card payments are waiting on documentation.
empty.reimbursementHint: If you paid another way and want the money back, use "Ask to be paid back" instead.

done.title: Receipt sent
done.subtitle: We've sent it to DMBA's spending-account administrator. Nothing else is needed from you.

viewer.title: Receipt
viewer.loadError: We couldn't open that receipt. Please try again.
viewer.acknowledgedNotice: This receipt is on file as a document rather than a photo, so it can't be shown here. Contact Member Services if you need a copy.
viewer.unsupported: We can't display this file here. Contact Member Services if you need a copy.

fork.question: What would you like to do?
fork.subtitle: These are two different things, so it's worth checking which one you need.

cardCharge.title: Send a receipt for a card payment
cardCharge.body: You already paid with your DMBA benefits card and were asked for documentation.
cardCharge.outcome: No money moves — you're documenting a payment you already made.
cardCharge.noCard: You don't have an active benefits card, so there's nothing to document.

reimbursement.title: Ask to be paid back
reimbursement.body: You paid another way — cash, a personal card, or a cheque — and want the money back.
reimbursement.outcome: Money moves — you'll be reimbursed from your account.

whatYouNeed.title: What you'll need
whatYouNeed.subtitle: Have these ready so you don't have to start over.
whatYouNeed.itemizedReceipt: An itemized receipt or statement — not just a card slip
whatYouNeed.serviceDate: The date you received the service
whatYouNeed.provider: The name of who you paid
whatYouNeed.footnote: You can take a photo of your receipt during this process — you don't need to upload it beforehand.

day.providerTaxId: Your care provider's Tax ID number
day.dependentDetails: Your dependent's full name and date of birth

category.question: What kind of expense was this?
category.subtitle: This decides which of your accounts pays the claim, so pick the closest match.
category.payrollFundedNote: Dependent Care claims are paid from what has been taken out of your pay so far, not your full yearly election. If your claim is for more than that, the rest is paid as more is deducted.

medical.helper: Use this for anything health-related that isn't dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care.
medical.examples: Doctor visits, hospital bills, physical therapy, chiropractic, medical equipment

dental.examples: Cleanings, fillings, crowns, braces, oral surgery

vision.examples: Eye exams, glasses, contact lenses, prescription sunglasses

supplies.label: Supplies & over-the-counter items
supplies.helper: Things you buy without a prescription.
supplies.examples: Bandages, pain relievers, allergy medicine, thermometers, sunscreen

day.helper: Care for a child or adult dependent so that you can work.
day.examples: Daycare, preschool, after-school care, day camp, adult day care

claimant.question: Who was this expense for?
claimant.subtitle: You can file a claim for yourself or anyone covered on your plan.

details.title: Tell us about the expense
details.endDateHelp: Only needed if the service covered more than one day.
details.providerHelp: The clinic, pharmacy, or provider you paid.

receiptRequirements.title: What your receipt needs to show
receiptRequirements.subtitle: Receipts missing any of these are usually denied, so it's worth checking before you take the photo.
receiptRequirements.provider: Who you paid — the provider or store name
receiptRequirements.date: The date you received the service or bought the item
receiptRequirements.description: What it was for — the service or item, not just "payment"
receiptRequirements.notAcceptable: A card slip showing only a total isn't enough on its own — it doesn't say what the charge was for.

review.title: Check your claim
review.accountNote: DMBA's spending-account administrator decides which of your accounts pays this claim, based on the type of expense you chose.
review.certifyLabel: I have read and agree to the statement above.
review.offlineBlock: You're offline, so this claim can't be submitted yet. Your receipt is saved — come back when you have a connection.

submitted.title: Claim submitted
submitted.subtitle: We've sent your claim to DMBA's spending-account administrator.

validation.amountNumeric: Enter an amount using numbers only.
validation.amountDecimals: Enter the amount in dollars and cents, like 42.50.
validation.amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.amountMax: That amount looks higher than expected — check what you entered.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end date can't be before the start date.
validation.dateInFuture: Enter the date you received the service. It can't be in the future.
validation.sameMonthService: This plan doesn't accept claims for services in the current month yet. You can submit it next month.
validation.dateOutsidePlanWindow: That date is outside your plan year.
validation.submitDeadlinePassed: The last day to submit claims for this plan year was {{date}}. Contact Member Services if you have questions.
validation.categoryNotOffered: That expense type isn't available on your plan.
validation.claimantNotEligible: That person isn't covered on your plan.
validation.providerMaxLength: That name is too long. Please shorten it.
validation.notesMaxLength: Those comments are too long. Please shorten them.

claimSubmission.title: Submit a claim

discardGuard.title: Discard this claim?
discardGuard.message: If you leave now, anything you've entered — including any files you've attached — will be lost.

patient.question: Who was this claim for?
patient.subtitle: Choose yourself or a family member covered on your plan.
patient.placeholder: Select who this claim is for

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.subtitle: Attach a photo or PDF of your itemized bill. A proof of payment is optional.
attachments.billHelp: Required — a bill showing the provider, date, and charges.
attachments.proofHelp: Optional — a receipt or statement showing you paid.
attachments.maxCombinedNote: You can attach up to {{max}} files total across both.

review.title: Review your claim
review.note: We'll route this to DMBA Member Services, who will follow up on your claim thread.

fields.descriptionHelp: A short description, like "Annual physical" or "X-ray, left ankle."
fields.alreadyPaid: Have you already paid for this?

errors.patientRequired: Choose who this claim is for.
errors.providerTooLong: That name is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.serviceDateRequired: Enter the date you received the service.
errors.serviceDateFuture: The date of service can't be in the future.
errors.serviceDateTooOld: That date is more than 24 months ago. Contact Member Services for an older claim.
errors.amountInvalid: Enter a valid dollar amount, like 42.50.
errors.amountTooManyDecimals: Enter the amount in dollars and cents, like 42.50.
errors.descriptionTooLong: That description is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.alreadyPaidRequired: Let us know whether you've already paid.
errors.billAttachmentRequired: Attach a photo or PDF of your itemized bill.
errors.attachmentsTooMany: You can attach up to {{max}} files total.
errors.submitFailed: We couldn't submit your claim. Please try again.

enroll.title: Sign-in verification
enroll.notEnrolledBody: Turn this on and, when you sign in to dmba.com, we'll send this phone a request to approve. You confirm with Face ID or your fingerprint instead of a code.
enroll.browserNote: You'll be asked to sign in to DMBA again so we know it's you.
enroll.biometricsNotEnrolledTitle: Set up Face ID or your fingerprint first
enroll.biometricsNotEnrolledBody: Approving a sign-in always takes Face ID or a fingerprint, so your phone needs one set up before you can turn this on. Add it in your phone's settings, then come back.
enroll.pushDeniedBody: We send the approval request as a notification, so notifications for the DMBA app need to be allowed.
enroll.openSettingsHint: Opens the DMBA app's settings on your phone
enroll.enrolledBody: When you sign in to dmba.com, we'll send this phone a request to approve with Face ID or your fingerprint.
enroll.removeHint: Asks you to confirm, then to sign in to DMBA again
enroll.removeConfirmMessage: You'll go back to your other sign-in method for dmba.com. You can set this phone up again at any time.
enroll.invalidatedBiometricBody: Face ID or your fingerprint changed on this phone, so the approval it was using is no longer valid. Setting it up again takes a moment.
enroll.invalidatedRemovedBody: This phone is no longer set up to approve sign-ins for your account. You can set it up again below.
enroll.errorBody: We couldn't check whether this phone is set up to approve sign-ins.
enroll.unsupportedBody: This phone can't be used to approve dmba.com sign-ins. You can keep using your other sign-in method.
enroll.enrolledAnnouncement: Sign-in verification is on for this device.
enroll.removedAnnouncement: Sign-in verification has been removed from this device.

verify.title: Approve sign-in?
verify.body: Someone signed in with your DMBA username and password and needs to confirm it's you. If this wasn't you, deny it.
verify.unknownOrigin: We weren't told where this request came from
verify.approveHint: Completes the sign-in on the other device
verify.deny: Deny — I didn't try to sign in
verify.denyHint: Stops the sign-in on the other device
verify.biometricPrompt: Confirm it's you to approve this sign-in

approved.title: Approved
approved.message: You're signed in on the other device. You can close this.

denied.title: Sign-in denied
denied.message: Nobody was signed in. If you didn't try to sign in, change your password — someone else may know it.

expired.title: This request expired
expired.message: Sign-in requests are only good for a short time. Try signing in again to get a new one.

userVerificationCancelled.title: Sign-in denied
userVerificationCancelled.message: We couldn't confirm it was you, so the sign-in was denied. Try again, or change your password if it wasn't you.

userVerificationFailed.title: Sign-in denied
userVerificationFailed.message: Your phone couldn't confirm it was you, so the sign-in was denied. Check that Face ID or your fingerprint is set up, then try again.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.message: We couldn't reach DMBA to answer this request. Check your connection and try signing in again.
